correctness.rationale: The proof establishes exact ordinal-gap correspondence, the uniform convergent-denominator lower entropy bound H_n>=log(q/3), and the conditional-information upper bound H_n<=log q+h(2n/Q)+(2n/Q)log n for n<=Q/4. These yield both logarithmic endpoints at q and Q/(log Q)^2, including the cases mu=2 and mu=infinity. The standard convergent error characterization gives mu=1+limsup log Q/log q. The one-gap Shannon increment is at most log2, forcing all intermediate accumulation values. Explicit definitions and boundary quantifiers have been checked; the final bundled checker passed and supports, rather than substitutes for, the infinite argument.
